title: Aether v2.1 — extension implementation plan
cadence: one pending item per hourly run

phases.name: Foundation
phases.summary: MV3 shell, side panel, content script, service worker, offscreen, Nano + heuristic engines.

phases.name: Side panel & state
phases.summary: Editable fields, confidence, undo, conflict modal, source verify.

phases.name: Language & Unicode
phases.summary: Language-parameterized extraction, JP/DE/EN names and addresses.

phases.name: Self-healing harness
phases.summary: Link scoring, background tabs, merge, circuit breakers.

phases.name: Performance & cache
phases.summary: DOM sanitize, chunking, chrome.storage schema cache.

phases.name: Security & governance
phases.summary: CSP, PII mask, no page JS in extension context.

phases.name: Quality & ship
phases.summary: Tests, options page, i18n, store listing.

items.title: Manifest V3 scaffold
items.detail: sidePanel, service worker modules, content script, offscreen document, icons, CSP.
items.done_when: Unpacked load opens the side panel from the action icon.

items.title: Sanitize + Markdown serialize
items.detail: Strip scripts/SVG/trackers; convert semantic DOM to Markdown; collect links.
items.done_when: AETHER_SERIALIZE returns url, title, lang, markdown, links.

items.title: Nano + heuristic inference
items.detail: Prompt API when available; schema JSON; heuristic fallback.

items.title: Editable dossier UI
items.detail: Inline fields, C-suite cards, confidence badges, JSON/MD export, PII toggle.
items.done_when: Every field is editable; export downloads a file.

items.title: Self-heal harness v1
items.detail: Score About/Team/Impressum links; hidden tabs; merge; max 4 pages / depth 2.
items.done_when: A sparse homepage fills executives from /leadership.

items.title: Engine unit tests
items.detail: Add tests/engine.test.mjs covering extractFromMarkdown, scoreLinks, mergeRecords (including dirty-field conflicts), maskValue, isComplete. Run with node --test.
items.done_when: node --test tests/engine.test.mjs exits 0 with cases for merge conflict, JP/DE fixtures, and DLP mask.
items.notes: Added node --test suite covering extract, scoreLinks, dirty merge conflicts, JP/DE fixtures, and DLP mask.

items.title: Harness circuit-breaker tests
items.detail: Test max pages, visited-url registry, score threshold skip, and cache short-circuit without calling fetchPage.
items.done_when: node --test tests/harness.test.mjs exits 0; a looping link graph cannot exceed MAX_PAGES.
items.notes: Added harness circuit-breaker tests; visited registry marks URLs before fetch so looping graphs stay within MAX_PAGES.

items.title: Chunked DOM map-reduce
items.detail: If markdown would exceed 8k tokens, split by section (h1–h3), infer each chunk, merge records. Keep a single-pass path for small pages.
items.done_when: A 20k-word fixture is chunked; company_name and executives still merge into one record.
items.notes: Split oversized markdown on h1–h3, infer per chunk, merge into one record; serialize cap raised for long pages.

items.title: Route inference through offscreen
items.detail: Service worker must not call LanguageModel. Send AETHER_OFFSCREEN_INFER to the offscreen document and use the result. Heuristic may still run in SW if offscreen is unavailable.
items.done_when: Primary and second-pass infer go through chrome.runtime.sendMessage to offscreen when the document exists.
items.notes: Harness accepts infer(); SW sends AETHER_OFFSCREEN_INFER and falls back to extractFromMarkdown without LanguageModel.

items.title: Options page
items.detail: chrome_url_overrides-free options.html: default PII mask, max pages (2–6), force-heuristic toggle, clear-cache button. Persist in chrome.storage.sync.
items.done_when: chrome://extensions options opens; harness reads max pages from storage.
items.notes: Added options_ui; sync settings drive harness maxPages and force-heuristic.

items.title: Persist undo history
items.detail: Store last 20 record snapshots per origin in chrome.storage.session (fallback local). Restore undo/redo across side-panel reloads.
items.done_when: Edit a field, close and reopen the panel, Undo still reverts.
items.notes: Persisted record plus 20 undo/redo snapshots per origin in session storage with local fallback.

items.title: Background tab cap + cleanup
items.detail: Never more than 2 hidden heal tabs at once. Always remove the tab in a finally. Timeout 8s already exists — surface failures in the log.
items.done_when: Three scored links never leave more than two extra tabs open; all are closed after the run.
items.notes: Heal fetches use a 2-slot semaphore, always remove the tab in finally, and log 8s timeouts to the panel.

items.title: Stable source IDs in the DOM
items.detail: During serialize, stamp data-aether-id on heading/email/phone/person nodes. Highlight uses that id instead of XPath-on-snippet.
items.done_when: Verify source scrolls to the exact node on a live corporate page with duplicate names.
items.notes: Serialize stamps data-aether-id on heading/email/phone/person nodes; Verify source highlights by id, not XPath.

items.title: CSV export and clipboard
items.detail: Export executives as CSV. Copy-record copies JSON (respecting PII mask) to clipboard with a short toast.
items.done_when: CSV downloads with name,role,email columns; copy writes masked JSON when PII is on.
items.notes: CSV export of executives (name,role,email) and Copy writes PII-aware JSON with a toast.

items.title: Side panel UI locale
items.detail: chrome.i18n with _locales/en, de, ja for chrome-facing strings (Extract, Record, Mask PII, C-suite). Page extraction already preserves Unicode.
items.done_when: Chrome UI language de shows German chrome strings; extracted JP names are unchanged.
items.notes: Added chrome.i18n locales en/de/ja; side panel chrome strings use getMessage; extracted field values stay as-is.

items.title: Mask PII before cache write
items.detail: Optional storage flag maskCache. When on, emails/phones are masked in chrome.storage.local schemas. Default off so re-extract can still heal. Document in README.
items.done_when: With the flag on, storage get of the schema has no raw email/phone.
items.notes: maskCache (default off) runs maskRecordForCache before writing domain schemas so stored email/phone are redacted.

items.title: Web Store listing draft + test script
items.detail: STORE.md (name, short/long description, privacy), and tests/manual.md with a 10-step unpacked QA checklist.
items.done_when: STORE.md and tests/manual.md exist and README links both.
